# Member Service Portal Project Charter

## Objective

Provide employees with one place to submit internal service requests, follow
their status, and search completed requests.

## Initial Scope

- Employee access through the organizational identity service.
- Request submission with attachments.
- Manager approval before a request enters a service queue.
- Assignment, status tracking, comments, and closure.
- Search and monthly operational reporting.

## Delivery

All departments will start using the portal on 15 October. The shared mailbox
will stop accepting new requests on that date.

## Governance

The operations director sponsors the project. Department managers validate
business rules. The technology manager validates implementation decisions.

## Records

Closed requests and their attachments must remain searchable for five years.
